content.text:
# Can Sarah Chen approve DR-9001?

**No, Sarah Chen can't approve this herself.** Acme is entitled to the 15% under its contract, but under the 2026 policy a 15% discount needs approval from the VP Sales, Michael Torres.

**Request matches the system of record.** DR-9001 in Northstar CRM matches what was submitted:
- Account: CRM-2048
- Product: NS-500
- Discount: 15%, which is $37,500 on a $250,000 list price
- Requested by Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23
- Status: Pending Approval

The NS-500 list price in the product catalog is $250,000, so the figures check.

**Customer identity is confirmed.** CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" is the same company as ERP customer C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings." Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the same Milwaukee address. This is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091), which is a different company.

**Acme is entitled to the 15% discount.**
- The Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31 and covers the NS-500. Its section 3.2 makes Acme eligible for up to 15% on the NS-500.
- The pricing exception attached to it as Schedule B (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) confirms this. It covers the NS-500 only, sets a maximum of 15%, and is valid from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31.
- The requested 15% is at that maximum, not above it.
- The older 10% exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-10) was replaced by the new one and doesn't apply.

**Sarah Chen doesn't have the authority.**
- The 2026 Pricing Policy applies to a request dated 2026-09-23.
- Under that policy, an Enterprise Account Executive can approve up to 10%. Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need the VP Sales, and the Approval Authority Matrix says the same.
- Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so her limit is 10%. The VP Sales role is held by Michael Torres, who is also her manager.
- The contract doesn't change who can approve. Section 3.3 of the agreement and the exception's own Authority section both say this, and so does the Sales Discount SOP.
- Last September Sarah approved 15% for Acme herself (DR-8104), but that was under the 2025 policy, which allowed Account Executives up to 15%. That policy no longer applies.
- The 2027 policy only takes effect on 2027-01-01, so it doesn't apply either.

**Approval must be recorded.** Because the discount is above 10%, the approval has to be recorded in Northstar CRM.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9001", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "eligible",
                             "maximum_discount": 15.0, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and Schedule B EXC-ACME-NS500-15 (NS-500 only, 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31)"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/products.csv (NS-500)", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Record the VP Sales approval in Northstar CRM (required for discounts above 10%)", "who": "Michael Torres", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
